owner_calls.question: In Secret Invasion ep 1, Gravik takes over the Skrull Council and Talos is exiled and stripped of his rank as general. He then works only with Fury against Gravik's Skrull Resistance. Does that end his 'Skrulls' stage? Separately, in Spider-Man: Far From Home Talos, posing as Fury, commands Fury's tactical team (Dimitri and others), which the screen never names. Should that team be a group?
options: Keep 'Skrulls' as his last stage (the group means the Skrull people, not the Council)
Add a departure from the Skrulls at Secret Invasion (exiled from the Council)
Add Fury's team at Spider-Man: Far From Home under a dataset name, if one exists
No change for the Far From Home team
owner_calls.evidence: Secret Invasion ep 1 'Resurrection': Talos tells Fury he was pushed out of the Skrull Council. Far From Home: Talos runs Fury's field team as Fury.

owner_calls.question: In Wonder Man, while spying for Damage Control, Trevor auditions for and is cast as Barnaby in Von Kovak's Wonder Man remake, and works on the production for the rest of the series. Does a film production count as an employer group?
options: No change (an acting job, not an organization)
Add the Wonder Man production as a stage at Wonder Man
owner_calls.evidence: Wonder Man: Trevor auditions for and accepts the role of Barnaby, then films the movie, until he is arrested by the DODC.

owner_calls.question: In Black Panther, Klaue runs an arms-smuggling crew (Linda, Limbani, and Erik Stevens/Killmonger, who serves in it until he kills Klaue). The screen never names the crew. Should Klaue, and Killmonger between his U.S. Military and Wakanda stages, get a stage for it?
options: Add Klaue's crew under a name the owner picks, for Klaue at Black Panther and for Killmonger at Black Panther, before Wakanda
owner_calls.evidence: Black Panther: Klaue's team robs the Museum of Great Britain and runs the Busan deal. Killmonger takes part, then kills Klaue.

owner_calls.question: In Captain America: The Winter Soldier, Batroc leads a crew of mercenaries ('Top mercs, led by this guy, Georges Batroc') who seize the Lemurian Star. The screen never names the crew. Should he get a stage for it between DGSE and LAF, instead of Independent?
options: Replace Independent at Captain America: The Winter Soldier with an owner-chosen name for Batroc's mercenary crew
owner_calls.evidence: Captain America: The Winter Soldier: Rumlow's briefing names Batroc as the leader of the mercenaries holding the ship.
